subject: DI05019011

body.en:
Definition / principle

GT identifies similarities among parts/processes so common design and production knowledge can be reused.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Part family is a set with meaningful design and/or processing similarity; identical appearance alone is not sufficient.
  • Benefits: less duplicated planning, standard tooling, shorter setup, better scheduling and potential WIP/lead-time reduction when implemented well.
  • GT is a grouping philosophy; cellular manufacturing physically/operationally groups resources for families. It does not require every machine to be automated.
Can similar-looking shafts be grouped without routing data?

Appearance is only a clue. Check process route, material, tolerance, volume and capacity before committing a cell.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

GT parts/processesની similarities ઓળખી common design, production knowledge reuse કરે.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Part family meaningful design/processing similarityવાળો set;ફક્ત similar appearance પૂરતું નહિ.
  • Benefits planning duplication/setup ઓછાં, standard tooling, better scheduling, potential WIP/lead-time reduction.
  • GT grouping philosophy; cellular manufacturing families માટે resources group કરે;દરેક machine automated હોવું જરૂરી નહિ.
Similar દેખાતા Shaftsને Routing Data વગર Group કરાય?

Appearance ફક્ત clue છે; cell final કરતાં પહેલાં route, material, tolerance, volume, capacity તપાસો.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Features describe design and processing attributes used to form useful families.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Design features: overall form, dimensions, holes, slots, material, tolerance, surface requirements.
  • Manufacturing features: operation sequence, machine type, tooling, setup direction, heat treatment and inspection method.
  • Example: two visually similar shafts may need different heat-treatment/grinding routes; two different brackets may share the same drill/mill setup family.
  • Choose attributes from the business problem; avoid grouping on an irrelevant colour or drawing number.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Features useful families માટે design, processing attributes વર્ણવે.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Design features overall form, dimensions, holes, slots, material, tolerance, surface.
  • Manufacturing features sequence, machine, tooling, setup direction, heat treatment, inspection.
  • Similar shaftsનાં heat-treatment/grinding routes જુદાં; different brackets same drill/mill setup family share કરી શકે.
  • Business problem પ્રમાણે attributes; irrelevant colour/drawing number પરથી grouping નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Classification must represent both product requirements and feasible routing.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Visual inspection: fast initial grouping but subjective and difficult for very large variety.
  • Classification/coding: structured design/manufacturing attributes enable retrieval; code design and data maintenance cost effort.
  • Production-flow analysis: group using routing/operation data; poor routing records can produce misleading cells.
  • Hybrid approach combines attributes, route similarity, volume and capacity; family boundaries can change with demand.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Classification product requirements, feasible routing બન્ને દર્શાવે.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Visual inspection fast initial,પણ subjective/large varietyમાં મુશ્કેલ.
  • Coding attributesથી retrieval; code design, data maintenance effort.
  • Production-flow analysis routing/operations પરથી; poor records misleading cells.
  • Hybrid attributes, routes, volume, capacity જોડે; demandથી boundaries બદલાય.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A useful cell matches family workload to resources without hiding bottlenecks or exceptional operations.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Collect component routes, volumes, cycle/setup times, quality requirements and existing capacity.
  • Build part-machine incidence/routing matrix and identify blocks with common operation needs.
  • Propose families/cells; identify exceptional parts requiring intercell moves and shared services.
  • Balance workload, tooling, operators and bottlenecks before physically moving machines.
  • Choose layout and buffers with access, safety and handling flow; standardise changeovers.
  • Pilot and compare WIP, lead time, setup, quality and utilisation; revise based on measured results.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Useful cell family workloadને resources સાથે match કરે; bottlenecks/exceptions છુપાવતું નહિ.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Routes, volumes, cycle/setup, quality, capacity data મેળવો.
  • Part-machine incidence/routing matrix બનાવી common blocks ઓળખો.
  • Families/cells propose; exceptional intercell moves, shared services ઓળખો.
  • Machines move પહેલાં workload, tools, operators, bottleneck balance.
  • Access, safety, flow સાથે layout/buffers; changeovers standardise.
  • Pilot પછી WIP, lead time, setup, quality, utilisation compare; measured resultsથી revise.

h.en: 4.1.5 GT layout versus conventional process layout
h.gu: 4.1.5 GT Layout સામે Conventional Process Layout

body.en:
Definition / principle

Process layout groups similar machines; cell layout groups different needed processes around a family.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Conventional example: all lathes in one department, all mills elsewhere, all drills elsewhere; parts queue and travel between departments.
  • Cell example: turn→mill→drill→inspect resources arranged for a shaft family; shorter routes and visual control can reduce handling.
  • GT layout can be U-shaped, linear or another suitable arrangement; U-shape is not the definition of GT.
  • Cell limits: duplicate resources, unbalanced load, exceptional routes and changing mix can offset benefits; process layouts retain broad routing flexibility.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Process layout similar machines group; cell layout family માટે needed different processes group કરે.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Conventional: all lathes એક department, mills/drills બીજે; parts queue/travel કરે.
  • Cell: shaft family માટે turn→mill→drill→inspect; short routes/visual controlથી handling ઘટે.
  • GT U-shaped/linear/other;ફક્ત U-shape GTની definition નહિ.
  • Cell limits duplicate resources, unbalanced load, exceptions, mix changes; process layout broad routing flexibility રાખે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Source case gives15shaft variants,8conventional machines, high setups/WIP and12-day lead time; it provides no measured post-improvement result.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Group shafts by actual operation sequence, diameter/length range, material/heat treatment and tolerance—not all15automatically into one family.
  • Propose a cell for compatible routes, shared presets/standard tools and smaller controlled transfer batches; keep special grinding/heat-treatment routes explicit.
  • Use CIM-linked route/inventory data first; consider FMS only if volume/mix, repeatability and investment justify it.
  • Measure setup hours, WIP units, first-pass yield, moves and actual lead time before/after pilot. No promised12→3days or invented cost saving is claimed.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Source case15shaft variants,8machines, high setups/WIP,12-day lead time આપે; post-improvement measured result આપતું નથી.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Actual sequence, size range, material/heat treatment, toleranceથી group;બધા15એક family automatically નહિ.
  • Compatible routes માટે cell, presets/tools, small controlled transfer batches; special grinding/heat-treatment explicit.
  • પહેલાં CIM-linked route/inventory; FMS volume/mix, repeatability, investment justify થાય તો.
  • Pilot પહેલાં/પછી setup hours, WIP, yield, moves, lead time measure;12→3days/cost saving invent નહિ.

h.en: 4.2.1 CIM: need, definition and functional integration

body.en:
Definition / principle

CIM integrates manufacturing-related information and activities through coordinated computer systems and data, not merely isolated CNC machines.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Need: reduce repeated data entry, conflicting revisions, planning delays and poor shop-floor visibility.
  • CAD/product definition supplies geometry, materials and tolerances; CAPP develops routes and process requirements; CAM supports manufacturing instructions.
  • Production planning, capacity, scheduling, purchasing and inventory connect resources and demand.
  • Shop-floor execution, handling/tooling and inspection capture actual status and feed quality/production data back.
  • Database/revision control and interfaces maintain consistent meaning; integration can be staged and does not require one monolithic software brand.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

CIM coordinated computers, dataથી manufacturing information/activities integrate કરે;ફક્ત isolated CNC નહિ.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Need repeated entry, conflicting revisions, planning delays, poor visibility ઘટાડવા.
  • CAD geometry/material/tolerances; CAPP routes/process; CAM manufacturing instructions.
  • Planning, capacity, scheduling, purchasing, inventory resources, demand જોડે.
  • Shop-floor execution, handling/tooling, inspection actual status લઈને feedback આપે.
  • Database/revision/interfaces consistent meaning રાખે; staged integration શક્ય,એક brand જરૂરી નહિ.

h.en: 4.2.2 CIM block diagram: read information both ways

body.en:
Definition / principle

A plan-only chain is incomplete; actual production and quality must feed information back.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Order/product need→design/CAD→planning/CAPP/CAM→scheduling/execution→manufacturing and inspection.
  • Common data services support product revisions, resources, inventory, tooling and quality records.
  • Feedback: completion, tool state, quality deviation and downtime update decisions; automation cannot repair incorrect master data by itself.
  • Importance: traceability, coordination and faster engineering change; limitations: interoperability, cybersecurity, training and implementation cost.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

ફક્ત planning chain અધૂરી; actual production, quality feedback આપે.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Order/need→CAD→CAPP/CAM→scheduling/execution→manufacture/inspect.
  • Common data product revisions, resources, inventory, tooling, quality support કરે.
  • Completion, tool state, quality deviation, downtime decisions update કરે; wrong master data automation પોતે સુધારે નહિ.
  • Traceability, coordination, faster changes; limits interoperability, cybersecurity, training, cost.

h.en: 4.3.1 FMC versus FMS: concept and scope

body.en:
Definition / principle

A flexible manufacturing cell combines processing, handling and control at cell scope; an FMS coordinates multiple processing resources and automated handling for a planned part mix.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • FMC may centre on one capable machine or a small group with supporting handling; definitions vary, so do not invent a universal machine-count boundary.
  • FMS needs integrated routing, scheduling, tool/work identification and status feedback, not just several CNC machines next to each other.
  • Flexibility includes part-mix, routing, volume and tool/changeover capability within a designed envelope—not ability to make any product instantly.
  • Advantages: reduced manual transfer, repeatable control and faster mix changes; limits: high investment, complexity, bottlenecks and dependency on reliable tooling/data.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

FMC cell-scope processing, handling, control જોડે; FMS planned mix માટે multiple resources, automated handling coordinate કરે.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • FMC એક capable machine/small group આસપાસ; definitions vary, universal machine-count boundary નહિ.
  • FMS routing, scheduling, tool/work ID, status feedback જોઈએ;ફક્ત adjacent CNCs નહિ.
  • Flexibility part-mix, routing, volume, changeover designed envelopeમાં;કોઈપણ product instantly નહિ.
  • Benefits transfer ઓછું, repeatability, fast mix changes; limits investment, complexity, bottlenecks, reliable tools/data.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Compare route alternatives, handling distance, expansion, congestion and access—not names alone.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • In-line: stations along a dominant route; simple flow but bypass/alternative routing depends on designed branches.
  • Loop: closed circulation path serves stations; buffer/control prevents recirculation congestion.
  • Ladder: cross-links between parallel routes provide more path choice but greater traffic/control complexity.
  • Open-field/network: multiple interconnected paths suit varied routing; investment, dispatch and deadlock prevention become important.
  • Robot-centred cell: stations around robot reach; compact transfer, but reach, payload and single shared handler can constrain capacity.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Route alternatives, distance, expansion, congestion, access compare કરો,ફક્ત names નહિ.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • In-line dominant route પર stations; simple flow, alternative routing branches પર.
  • Loop closed path stations serve; buffer/control congestion અટકાવે.
  • Ladder parallel routes cross-links; more choice, more control complexity.
  • Open-field/network multiple paths; investment, dispatch, deadlock control મહત્વનાં.
  • Robot-centred reach આસપાસ stations; compact,પણ reach, payload, shared-handler capacity limits.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Tool handling places the correct identifiable, conditioned tool at the required machine/time.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Elements: tool store, holders/presets, magazines, ATC or transfer devices, and identification/life data.
  • Flow: prepare/preset→identify→store/route→load magazine→change tool under machine control→track wear/life→return/replace.
  • Function includes offsets, compatibility and sister-tool availability; physical tool presence alone is insufficient.
  • Limits: wrong ID/offset, missing tools, magazine constraints and shared-tool bottlenecks interrupt production.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Tool handling correct identifiable, conditioned toolને required machine/timeએ આપે.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Tool store, holders/presets, magazines, ATC/transfer, ID/life data.
  • Prepare/preset→identify→store/route→load→machine-controlled change→wear/life→return/replace.
  • Offsets, compatibility, sister-tool availability પણ;ફક્ત tool હાજર પૂરતું નહિ.
  • Wrong ID/offset, missing tools, magazine constraints, shared bottlenecks production અટકાવે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Handling moves, orients, buffers and identifies material/work between processing and storage resources.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Examples: conveyors, pallet systems, robots, AGVs and storage interfaces; choose by load, route, cycle time and environment.
  • Flow request→identify pallet/job→select route/resource→transfer→confirm arrival→update status; machine/handler interlocks prevent conflicting motion.
  • Buffers absorb variation but excess buffers hide WIP/lead time; handling capacity must match bottleneck demand.
  • Protect part orientation, datum surfaces and traceability rather than simply maximising transport speed.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Handling resources વચ્ચે material/work move, orient, buffer, identify કરે.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Conveyors, pallets, robots, AGVs, storage interfaces; load, route, cycle, environment મુજબ.
  • Request→ID→route/resource→transfer→arrival confirm→status; interlocks conflicting motion અટકાવે.
  • Buffers variation લે,પણ excess WIP છુપાવે; capacity bottleneck demand મુજબ.
  • ફક્ત speed નહિ; orientation, datum surfaces, traceability protect.

h.en: 4.3.5 AGV: construction concept and working functions

body.en:
Definition / principle

An automated guided vehicle carries material along a managed guidance/navigation system.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Elements: mobile base, drive/steering, power source, load interface, guidance/localisation, sensors and fleet communication.
  • Types by task: tow, unit-load, pallet/fork types as suitable; guidance may use paths/markers or other approved localisation.
  • Working: dispatch task→verify load/pickup→follow authorised route with obstacle/safety controls→dock/transfer→confirm status.
  • Functions: reduce manual transfers and connect resources; constraints include payload, docking, charging, traffic and human interaction.
  • AGV and more autonomously rerouting AMR labels can overlap in practice; do not assume obstacle detection equals permission to bypass safety zones.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

AGV managed guidance/navigationથી material લઈ જાય.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Mobile base, drive/steering, power, load interface, guidance/localisation, sensors, fleet communication.
  • Task મુજબ tow, unit-load, pallet/fork; guidance paths/markers/approved localisation.
  • Dispatch→load/pickup verify→authorised route, safety→dock/transfer→status.
  • Manual transfer ઓછાં, resources connect; limits payload, docking, charging, traffic, human interaction.
  • AGV/AMR labels overlap થઈ શકે; obstacle detection એટલે safety zones bypass permission નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Automated storage/retrieval coordinates addressed storage locations and mechanised retrieval with inventory control.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Elements: racks/bins, crane/shuttle or retrieval mechanism, input/output stations, identification, sensors and controller.
  • Types: unit-load, miniload, carousel/shuttle arrangements as applicable; select by item, size, throughput and access.
  • Working: verify incoming item→assign/confirm location→store→log status→schedule retrieval→verify and deliver at output.
  • Benefits: space use, traceability and repeatability; limits: throughput bottlenecks, inventory-data errors, investment and recovery from faults.
  • Load limits, access guarding and safe maintenance are engineered requirements, not software-only problems.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

AS/RS addressed locations, mechanised retrieval, inventory coordinate કરે.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Racks/bins, crane/shuttle, I/O stations, ID, sensors, controller.
  • Unit-load, miniload, carousel/shuttle; item, size, throughput, access મુજબ.
  • Incoming item verify→location→store→status→retrieval→verify/deliver.
  • Space, traceability, repeatability; limits throughput, data errors, cost, fault recovery.
  • Load limits, guarding, safe maintenance engineered requirements,ફક્ત software નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

The source term main frame refers to coordinating host computing; modern implementations need not use one physical legacy mainframe.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Functions: job scheduling, routing, resource/tool records, inventory interface, monitoring and production-data coordination.
  • Local CNC/PLC controllers execute machine actions; host-level plans do not replace local safety controls.
  • Status flows back from machines/handlers; host updates dispatch decisions within capacity and job priorities.
  • Data correctness, network resilience, backup and access control matter; loss of host connectivity must have a designed safe response.
May host scheduling replace local machine safety control?

No. Host coordinates jobs/resources; local CNC/PLC and safety systems retain their engineered responsibilities.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Sourceનું main frame coordinating host computing બતાવે; modernમાં physical legacy mainframe જ જરૂરી નહિ.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Functions scheduling, routing, tool/resource records, inventory, monitoring, data coordination.
  • Local CNC/PLC machine actions કરે; host plan local safetyનો substitute નહિ.
  • Machines/handlersથી status પાછું; capacity, priorities મુજબ dispatch update.
  • Correct data, resilience, backup, access control મહત્વનાં; connectivity lossનો designed safe response જોઈએ.
Host Scheduling Local Safetyને Replace કરે?

ના.Host jobs/resources coordinate કરે છે; local CNC/PLC તથા safety systemsની engineered responsibilities રહે છે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Use the supplied Rajkot case as an analysis exercise, not a claimed visit or implemented improvement.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Given baseline:15shaft variants,8conventional machines, process layout, high setups/large WIP and12-day lead time. No detailed routes, times, costs or improved results are supplied.
  • Collect or request routes, volumes, setup/cycle times, tolerances, utilisation, material movements and demand mix; flag unavailable data.
  • Propose GT families from design and routing features; draw current departmental and proposed cell flows with exceptions/shared resources.
  • Prioritise practical CIM data links and standard tooling/setup plans; assess whether FMS benefits justify capacity, investment and complexity.
  • Define pilot metrics: setup hours, WIP units, handling distance, first-pass yield, utilisation and measured lead time. Keep baseline and proposed targets separate.
  • Any target is illustrative and requires validation; do not invent a12→3day result or guaranteed percentage saving.
  • Report assumptions, layouts, AMS selection rationale, phased plan, risks, missing evidence and measurement method.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Rajkot supplied caseને analysis exercise તરીકે લો; visit/implemented improvementનો દાવો નહિ.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Baseline15shaft variants,8conventional machines, process layout, high setups/large WIP,12-day lead time; detailed routes, times, costs, improved results નથી.
  • Routes, volumes, setup/cycle, tolerances, utilisation, moves, demand mix મેળવો/માગો; missing flag.
  • Design/routing featuresથી families; current departments, proposed cells, exceptions/shared resources draw.
  • CIM data links, standard tools/setup plans prioritise; FMS capacity, investment, complexity સામે justify થાય તે assess.
  • Pilot metrics setup hours, WIP, distance, yield, utilisation, measured lead time; baseline/targets અલગ.
  • Targets illustrative, validation જરૂરી;12→3day result/guaranteed saving invent નહિ.
  • Assumptions, layouts, selection rationale, phased plan, risks, missing evidence, measurement method report.
